justification: Inspected byte-buddy-dep/src/main/java/net/bytebuddy/dynamic/loading/PackageDefinitionStrategy.java (777 lines) plus byte-buddy-dep/src/test/java/net/bytebuddy/dynamic/loading/PackageDefinitionStrategyTypeSimpleTest.java and PackageDefinitionStrategyTypeTrivialTest.java. The top-level interface has only one API method (`define`), and the file’s behavior is already split into focused nested types: `NoOp` and `Trivial` strategies, `Definition` with `Undefined`, `Trivial`, and `Simple`, and `ManifestReading` with `SealBaseLocator` variants. Each nested type has a narrow responsibility and few methods, so the class is a grouped API container rather than an insufficiently modular monolith.
